title: 刀与默契
logline: 深夜县医院急诊手术室，主刀医师程一舟与新晋器械护士苏芒以极简指令高效配合完成阑尾手术，展现医护人员的极致职业专注与默契。

shots.narrationZh: 深夜急诊铃响，两人冲进手术室。
shots.narrationEn: Late night emergency bell rings, both rush into the operating room.
shots.visual: Darkened county hospital operating room, bright surgical lamp illuminates green sterile drapes, wall clock shows 2AM, Cheng Yizhou with a brow scar in dark green full surgical cap and Su Mang in light green scrubs with only her focused eyes exposed prepare surgical instruments, monitor glows softly.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速稍快，气息短促带急迫感，重音落在「急诊」「冲」上，情绪紧绷，呈现深夜接急症的匆忙感

shots.visual: Close-up of Cheng Yizhou's rock-steady hand holding a scalpel, Su Mang's quick, light hand passes the blade to him, the instrument table with surgical tools is visible beside them.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速慢而稳，气息平稳无起伏，重音落在「刀」字上，情绪冷峻克制，凸显主刀医师的高度专注

shots.visual: Mid shot of the patient's exposed abdomen on the operating table, Cheng Yizhou utters 'gauze', Su Mang immediately hands over a pack of sterile gauze, the monitor's soft beeping is implied in the scene.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速适中偏沉，气息平稳下沉，重音落在操作精准感上，情绪沉稳内敛，传递手术中的高度专注

shots.visual: Cheng Yizhou peels off his surgical gloves and tosses them into the medical waste bin, he glances at Su Mang and says 'see you tomorrow', Su Mang nods with a faint smile under her mask.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速放缓，气息轻而松，无多余情绪起伏，情绪克制松弛，呈现手术结束后的平静收尾

shots.visual: Close-up of the surgical lamp casting bright light over the tidy operating room, the medical brand logo and slogan 'Professional Care for Every Surgery' appear at the bottom of the frame.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速适中偏稳，气息坚定有力量，重音落在「专业」「守护」上，情绪温暖笃定，传递职业坚守的质感
